operations.description: Phase 1: token-set Jaccard clustering with COMPLETE LINKAGE over a pre-sorted corpus. Complete linkage is what bounds chaining.
Phase 3: --stale DAYS lists unfixed entries older than DAYS. Lists only, never closes.
Phase 1/3: refuse --similarity 100 outright rather than aliasing it, dispatch --stale, apply opt-in clustering to the draft only, and add the flags.

edits.replace:
